shots.caption: CLASSIC crack intro: "DRAGON FL..." in turning vector letters
THALION logo over raining coloured drops
The red dragon spreads its wings on a rock at sunset
DRAGONFLIGHT title logo
Main Menu: New game, Old game, Backup gamedisk, Sequences, Credits
Backup Menu: Format Disk, Copy Disk, Help, Exit to Main Menu
Sequences asks for the backup Disk B (ESC to cancel)
Credits: Erik Simon (graphics), Udo Fischer (program), Jochen Hippel (music)
The sage holds the Rings of Stasis: first page of the intro
Pegana: the square where the party starts
Pegana: the road along the town's western edge
The land outside Pegana: river, road and the town icon
Deep forest south of Pegana
River bridge and a grey mountain east of Pegana
Panel on the land: four portraits, message scroll, command icons
Right button: the direction arrows replace the command icons
Camp on the land: the party around a campfire
Status of Bladus: hit points, magic, experience, food, gold
Inventory: gold, food and a torch
Spells page, empty at the start
Status of Dobranur, the dwarf: 120 hit points, no magic
Status of Bladus with a sword as weapon
Rinakles carries piece 02 of the Great Map
Examine: "That is a part of the world-map!"
Use: "You added the piece of map to the world-map!"
Magic icon: "Who should cast?" Rinakles: "You have no spell ready"
Inventory of Rinakles with a scroll and a potion
Use on a scroll: "Who should read this scroll?"
"Rinakles learned this spell": the scroll is gone
Spells page of Rinakles: Dazzle (w), a white spell
Prepare: Dazzle marked ready ("Spell ready")
Rinakles casts in Pegana: "Spell has failed!"
Hand icon at a house door in Pegana: "Nobody at home."
Speak: a red-haired young man tells of his brother, the torch trader in Drombul
In a talk: "Who should show something?"
"Your opponents' attack surprises you. They are Snakes!"
Fight with a snake: side view, overhead grid, orders for Bladus
Right button in a fight: arrows to move, Zz to wait
Orders given in turn: Bladus and Rinakles parry, Dobranur next
Bladus, next to the snake, hits it with his sword: "Bladus hit a Snake (27)!"
Encounter message: "They are Orcs!"
A band of orcs on the meadow
A skeleton
A ghost
A bear
A beast
A ghoul in a blue robe
A gnoll
A troll
A balron
An energyball
A statue strikes first: "Bladus has been mortually wounded!"
Guardians: heroes fall one by one and pass on their Rings of Stasis
The party is dead: "Is this the end of all hope?"
Disk menu: "Gamesave? Left YES Right NO"
"Game saved" after saving to Disk B
Disk menu, other disk: "Gameload? Left YES Right NO"
Old game loaded: "Thank You! Game loaded" on the land
The land: a cave arch in the eastern mountains, a dungeon entrance
Entered the cave: without light the dungeon view stays black
Bladus uses his torch: "The torch has been lighted!"
First-person dungeon: a long stone corridor by torchlight
Three steps forward along the corridor
Further on: doors in the side walls
Turn right: a wooden door at the end of the corridor
Backward into the wall: "Blocked"
Turned round and stepped up to a wooden door
The eye icon: "It is a Door!"
The hand icon at the door: it swings open onto a passage
Listen at the door: "Bladus: I can hear nothing!"
Key icon at the door: "The door is already open!"
Chest icon in a corridor: "There is no chest!"
Casting in the dark: "Who should cast ?"
Rinakles casts Light: "Gloomy lights appear! Spell has succeeded!"
Use on a map piece: "You added the piece of map to the world-map!"
Examine the Worldmap: the Great Map with one piece, the west coast
The Great Map with five of its twelve pieces
Use on a potion: the Mix potions screen with cauldron and flask
Click a potion: "Give to whom?" (to oneself = drink)
Bladus drinks a healing potion: "Healing power streams through the body!"
After the healing potion: Bladus has 62 of 100 hit points (was 37)
Potion of power: "Heat is spreading the body. Powers beyond belief..."
Magic potion: "The coolness of the liquid clears heads..."
Poison: "A bad and awful taste... It is poison!"
"Despite the oily smell Bladus drinks... he feels miserable."
"The taste of the potion is just great! ... an extremely old wine"
Mix potions with four kinds of potion: the cells hold Bladus's potions
A potion taken from a cell and poured into the cauldron
Two potions in the cauldron, their marks in the pipe below
The flask filled at the outlet: "Own potion mixed!", the new potion listed
Click on the mixed potion: "Give to whom?"
Bladus drinks the mix of two potions and feels miserable
Forest fight: Rinakles is ordered to cast "MAGIC ARROW!"
The magic arrow, a small spark, flies toward the snake
"Rinakles casted a spell!": his magic points fell from 10 to 2
Temple of Stormwind: "The temple shows no effect!"
Temple of Gemshine, a hidden icon north-east of Pegana
Drombul, the town in the north-eastern forest
Drombul: the party at the blacksmith's door
Hand at the door: "You enter." Renday's blacksmith, weapons and prices
Click on an item (short Sword, 77): "Sell to whom?"
Click on Bladus's portrait: the short sword is "sold to Bladus"
A sword for 240 to Rinakles: "Rinakles doesn't have enough money!"
A portrait in the shop: "List of: Bladus", what he can sell here
Click on his short sword: "Therefore I pay 24 GS. Yes / No"
Yes: the sword is sold, Bladus's list is empty again
Bladus's inventory after buying: 796 gold and the short sword
Gormen's healer: Bladus buys Mushroom 1 for 22 gold
Healing (18 gold) bought for Bladus: hit points 37 -> 75
The Oak Arbor, Firtul's inn: a beer for Bladus (4 gold)
The Orc Village in the west
